(Eppadi irukkeergal? - How are you?), மற்றும் "நன்றாக இருக்கிறேன்" (Nandraaga irukkiren - I am fine) போன்ற சொற்களைப் பற்றிப் பார்ப்போம். மேலும், எளிய வாக்கியங்களை உருவாக்குவதையும் பயிற்சி செய்வோம். உங்கள் தமிழ் பயணத்தைத் தொடங்க நீங்கள் தயாரா?

quiz.q: How do you say "Hello" in Tamil?
What is the Tamil word for "Thank you"?
Which Tamil word means "Yes"?
What does "இல்லை" mean in English?
If you want to ask "What is your name?", which Tamil word would you use for "What"?

lessons.tutorPrompt: Hello! Today, we're going to dive into some essential Tamil phrases. We'll learn how to say "Hello" (வணக்கம்), "Thank you" (நன்றி), "Yes" (ஆம்), "No" (இல்லை), and "What" (என்ன). I'll explain each word's meaning, pronunciation, and give you examples of how to use them in simple sentences. By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to greet people, express gratitude, and ask basic questions in Tamil. Let's start with 'வணக்கம்'!
